## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the small bin for table waste, pour balls into the bin.

Task description: Pick up the white mini trash can at the front left of the table and pour the red balls inside into the large trash can with a silver liner at the left edge of the table.

Success criteria: All 5 red balls must enter the large bin and settle low near its bottom, while the small bin remains raised well above the table. Emptying it while balls scatter on the table or outside the large bin does not count.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the small bin's upper wall facing the table center, one finger inside and one against the outer wall. Set the opening for rim thickness and approach clearance, avoiding the opening region through which balls will pour.
- Before closing, confirm fingers inside and outside the bucket wall with pads contacting the wall rather than only pressing the rim top. Check for slipping during a small test lift to reduce dropping after inversion.
- Keep the bucket opening facing upward during transport. Leave clearance between its bottom and the table edge and between its body and the mouse behind it to avoid collision and spilling balls before reaching above the large bin.
- During tipping, let the rim on the pouring side pass over the inner edge of the large bin, keeping the balls' landing point inside the opening. Leave room to rotate the small bin and gripper without hitting the large bin's edge.
- Gradually increase the tilt and check whether any balls remain at the bottom of the bin. If any remain, gently shake it while the opening still faces inside the larger bin, avoiding a forceful swing that sends balls over the rim.
